## Customize the Typography of Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/customize-the-typography-of-site/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Global → Typography

The Spacious theme allows you to add the typography options like font family, font size, line height, etc., to make your site look different and as you like.

Spacious has a dedicated customizer control for typography which allows you to change the following aspects of typography:

- Font Family

- Font Weight

- Font Size

- Line Height

- Style

- Transform

There are the following types of Typography Options:

### Base Typography

It applies to the post content, footer content, and sidebar content unless the typography settings of those specific sections override those.

### Headings Typography

It applies to the Heading areas of the site. In the Headings section, there are the following typography options:

- **Headings**: Changes the typography of HTML headings from H1 to H6.

- **H1**: Changes the typography of the HTML heading tag H1.

- **H2**: Changes the typography of the HTML heading tag H2.

- **H3**: Changes the typography of HTML heading tag H3.

- **H4**: Changes the typography of the HTML heading tag H4.

- **H5**: Changes the typography of the HTML heading tag H6.

- **H6**: Changes the typography of the HTML heading tag H6.

## Change the Background of Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/background-of-site/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Global → Background

The Spacious theme allows you to add the Background, i.e** Color**, and** Image** on your site. It provides two areas for changing the color, i.e, **Content Area** and** Outside Container**.

- **Content Area: **The content area refers to the specific area where all your theme content lies. Adding the background color to the content area will display the color all over the area where the content lies.

- **Outside Container: **It displays the background color/images outside the content area.

---

## Change the Heading Color of the Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/heading-color-of-the-site/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Global → Colors → Headings Color

Spacious theme allows you to change the color of the **Heading Tags**. It is for setting the default heading color that applies throughout your site.

It comes with the following options:

- **Headings: **Changes the color of HTML headings from H1 to H6

- **H1: **Changes the color of the HTML heading tag H1.

- **H2: **Changes the color of the HTML heading tag H2.

- **H3: **Changes the color of the HTML heading tag H3.

- **H4: **Changes the color of the HTML heading tag H4.

- **H4: **Changes the color of the HTML heading tag H5.

- **H5: Changes the color of the **HTML heading tag H6.

---

## Change the Skin Color of the Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/chnage-skin-color-of-the-site/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Global → Colors → Color Skin

The Spacious theme allows you to select Skin color for your site, i.e., **Light skin** or **Dark skin**. Normally the site adopts a Light skin color but looking at the ongoing period, most people prefer to read websites in the dark skin mode.

For a better user experience, all the well-known companies have adopted dark mode, including Google, Facebook, and Instagram. Your website looks more professional and is better for your eyes in dark mode.

---

## Customize the Primary Color of the Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/primary-color-of-the-site/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Global → Colors → Primary Colors

Spacious theme allows you to change the color of your site. You can achieve a uniform theme color for your site using this section. It is for setting the default color that applies throughout your whole site.

It comes with the following two options:

- **Primary Color**: It changes the primary theme color of the site.

- **Base Color**: It changes the basic color of the site, such as text, link color, etc.

---

## Manage the Sidebar Layout

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/manage-sidebar-layout/>

Sidebar in the theme refers to a column provided by the theme to display information other than those of the content area. The theme offers the option to display the sidebar in the right or left area of the content.

The Spacious theme allows displaying the sidebar on each page and customize them. Moreover, it offers the option to display the sidebar in the chose area for various pages such as **DefaultPage**, **Pages**, **Single PostPage**, etc.

---

## Manage the Site Layout

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/manage-site-layout/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Global → Layout → Site Layout

The Spacious theme allows you to customize the layout of your site, i.e., **Boxed** and **Width** Layout with different content widths. For now, we have 4 different options to manage the site layout within the Spacious theme.

**Sidebar Width**: The Spacious provided the option to namange the sidebar width of the site. You can set the sidebar width to be in percentage depending upon the site requirement.
